descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S26 「错的模型回答绝不到卡上：stub 出来的系列外代码，或者不匹配的代码/级别，会被纠正，或者显示成清楚的报错（两个模式）」 A wrong model answer never reaches the card: a stubbed out-of-family code or a mismatched code/level is overridden or shown as a clear error (both contexts)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 The code family is a fixed table keyed on the template, never chosen by the model: H&P and Consult -> 99221-99223 (some commercial payers accept 99252-99255); SOAP progress -> 99231-99233; …（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 1；TFA-92596 What (template -> family table)） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U10 The code and the stated level agree ('99232 / Low complexity' fails).（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U15 If the billing call fails, the call is retried automatically, the note is still shown and the billing area shows a clear error with a way to retry; …（UAT Empty & Failure States (Billing suggestion failed)；UAT 3.5；TFA-94745 AC 4）
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families.（UAT 3.3；UAT TC-21 step 6；TFA-92599 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Local 4510 stack with the billing model's response stubbed below the action (on main a local provider stub for ai/notes:suggestBilling; after PR #103 the provider call of the Generate-time billing step); a Hospital patient with a SOAP progress note and a resident with an SNF admission note

When Billing runs with the stub returning: (a) SOAP note -> 'CODE: 99223 / LEVEL: High'; (b) SNF admission note -> 'CODE: 99310 / LEVEL: High'; (c) SOAP note -> 'CODE: 99232 / LEVEL: Low'; (d) after #103, element levels that compute to one code while the stub states another

Then The card never shows 99223 on the SOAP note or 99310 on the SNF admission note; the code shown and its level agree ('99232 / Low' never appears); otherwise the billing area shows the clear error with retry (U15), never a blank card or a guessed code

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：From U1 'never chosen by the model' and U10: per stub, Pass if no out-of-family code is on the card and the shown code and level agree in the Q2 table, or the error card with retry shows; Fail if 99223 (a), 99310 (b) or '99232 / Low' (c) is shown. …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-c（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 FAULT · 故障注入；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S26 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-18.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：票没到 ready for qa · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92596 ready for pr；TFA-92599 in progress；TFA-94745 ready for qa

模型返回 99232 + Low 时，计费卡片照样显示「CODE: 99232 / LEVEL: Low Complexity」，代码和级别对不上；系列外的代码会正确变成「点此重试」提示。

When the model returns 99232 with level Low, the billing card shows 'CODE: 99232 / LEVEL: Low Complexity' even though code and level disagree. An out-of-family code is correctly replaced by a retry message.

依据：Allure ebb7e099, newspec-c blocked. Parts (a)/(b), which check the card only, pass. Part (c) fails because main has no code-level check. U10 is gated by TFA-92596 (ready for pr, PR #103), and (d) needs PR #103. The server path has not run yet; it needs a provider stub (fault-ai).

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-c。

测试方法：FAULT · 故障注入；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：newspec-c。

UAT item: TC-18 Billing Suggestion · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-18/S26

A wrong model answer never reaches the card: a stubbed out-of-family code or a mismatched code/level is overridden or shown as a clear error (both contexts)

Tickets: TFA-92596 Billing Suggestion (ready for pr); TFA-92599 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch (in progress); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

本地新 lane newspec-c：newspec-c/results.json 里 status blocked → 卡住（卡住）。

怎么测（newspec-c/plan.json，automatable: partly）：Two halves. Server half, deterministic: import the app's own billingCodeFamilyFor (convex/ai/billingCodes.ts) and check 99223 is not allowed for a SOAP note and 99310 not for an SNF admission note (the action throws 'Billing model returned a code outside the allowed family' for those, convex/ai/notes.ts). Browser half, Playwright on the local stack with seeded notes: (a) SOAP and (b) SNF admission: suggestBilling answered at the socket with that server failure -> the card must show the clear error with retry (U15), never 99223 / 99310 or a blank card, and the note stays shown; tapping retry sends a second request. (c) SOAP: suggestBilling answered with the exact text main's action would return for a model answer 'CODE 99232 / LEVEL Low' (main has no code-level check) -> the card must not show '99232' with 'Low'. (d) needs PR #103 (element levels) which is not on main. — A provider stub below the action would need a change to the shared 4510 backend (env or code), which this job may not touch. The family check is a pure function and the action's wiring is three lines, so the server half is checked by import + code reference, and the card half at the socket with the answers the server would really return. (d) cannot run until #103 merges. Review: (a)/(b) cover the card only; the server half is import + code reading (notes.ts:287-291); 'fault-ai' (a stub below the action) stays in needs.

Detail:

Ran, PARTLY covered (no re-run needed; patch changed). The server path never runs: the family rule was checked by importing billingCodeFamilyFor (convex/ai/billingCodes.ts: ('hospital','soap') = 99231-99233, ('snf','snf-admission') = 99304-99306) and by reading convex/ai/notes.ts:287-291 (suggestBilling throws 'Billing model returned a code outside the allowed family'). (a)/(b) cover the CARD only: fed that error at the socket, the card shows 'Couldn't generate billing suggestion — tap to retry', never 99223/99310, the note stays, retry sends a new request. (c) FAILS: fed a hand-built text matching what main's action returns for a model answer 99232 / Low, the card shows 'CODE: 99232 / LEVEL: Low Complexity' (no code-level check on main). U10 is gated by TFA-92596 (ready for pr, PR #103) -> Blocked. (d) needs PR #103, not on main. A provider stub below the action (fault-ai) is still needed for the server half.

产品问题：Hospital Post-Round, SOAP progress note: when the model answers 99232 with level Low, the billing card reads 'CODE: 99232 / LEVEL: Low Complexity' (code and level disagree). UAT TC-18 / TFA-92596 AC 7 ('99232 / Low complexity fails'). Gated: PR #103 not on main.

证据：附了 5 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our scripted spec, not written yet): it needs a provider stub below ai/notes:suggestBilling on the local 4510 backend (runnerGaps 10) and the local admin helpers; dev has no admin key and the runner never injects a fault or mocks a model there, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 20…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
